title: Issi son of Rav Yitzchak son of Rav Yehudah bar Yechezkel
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He is mentioned only in [Yevamot 64b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.64b.16): his daughter Chuma married Rachava of Pumbedita, who died; she then married Rav Yitzchak, son of Rabbah bar Bar Chana, who died; she then married Abaye.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked passage calls Chuma the daughter of Issi, son of Rav Yitzchak, son of Rav Yehudah, and gives the three marriages in the order Hyman records.
The consulted passage ends the family chain at Rav Yehudah; Hyman’s heading continues with bar Yechezkel. Hyman’s notice stops at the marriage to Abaye.
